race.comment: CERTIFIED COPY (3) returned in good order with a solid Rocky win before just running into one better at Coffs Harbour last time out. Strips fitter third-up now and gets some weight off from the low draw. Ticks a few boxes for a race of this calibre. SPIRIT OF BRODIE (2) grows a leg for hoop Apel who has three wins from as many steers and again gets the benefit of her 2kg claim. Sure to play a big role. LUMENS LENNY (6) is a two-time winner over this distance range and only needs some luck navigating from the wide draw to be featuring in the finish. ABSOLUTE SUNSHINE (1) comes here as the best of the rest while fresh.
